verdict.rationale: AgentMail's own documented integrations let an agent operate inboxes, messages, threads and attachments "using natural language". These are a first-party hosted MCP server, an official skills package for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, and a Google ADK integration. The natural-language layer, however, comes from an external LLM client; the product has no built-in natural-language console. missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in the product itself, hands-on or independent corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and documentation of which operations are reachable conversationally beyond the listed tool categories.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: your agent can create inboxes, send and receive emails, manage threads, and handle attachments using natural language.
AgentMail runs a hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp` that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, and calendar tools
This works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Codex, and other compatible agents: npx skills add agentmail-to/agentmail-skills
